proof_scope: FastAPI control-plane standards, deployment handoff boundaries, and Flask fallback adapter generation

claims.proves: the skill has an executable converter, validates route manifests with Pydantic, generates a Flask adapter over shared contracts/service, rejects invalid manifests, and documents Terraform as an external skill handoff
claims.does_not_prove: a deployed cloud service, production auth, real OpenAI/Astra access, or live cyber scanning

cases.name: skill-documents-terraform-external-boundary
command: grep -q "Terraform stays outside the app" ../SKILL.md && grep -q "Never reimplement" ../SKILL.md
